newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel to cut IDD rates up to 14.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: SingTel to cut IDD rates up to 14.6 pct.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) said on Monday it would cut its International Direct Dialling (IDD) rates to 106 destinations by up to 14.6 percent, effective July 1, 1997.
With the rate revision, SingTel's IDD rates to 219 destinations will cost below Singapore $3.00 per minute, a company statement said.
"This round of rate cuts will place SingTel in an even more competitive position against foreign carriers," said Ho Fah Siang, SingTel's vice president of international voice services.
"We are passing back a total of S$3 million in savings to our customers," Ho said.
